# SPE GeoHackathon 2026: Size first

## Summary

![Key figures](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)

The design delivers 111.7 GWh of heat and 23.74 GWh of cold a year. The levelised cost is 46.13 EUR/MWh. Geothermal covers 92% of the heating demand. The largest rated units are Peak boiler 30 MW, Compression cooler 20 MW, Compression chiller 10 MW. All 20 assessed checks pass.

## Plant

Design Size first from a study of kind Size the equipment, plant type Heating heat pump cooling plant.
